description:
Hushfeed v0.37.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

A maintenance release: nothing in the feed looks different. Auto translate comments stopped reading every field of every comment cell's manager, three times per cell, on the thread that binds the list, so a busy comment sheet scrolls without paying for that on every row. Follow diagnostics lets go of a request when its response parses or it fails, instead of holding up to 160 request graphs until TikTok is killed. The Android 17 audit is finished in source: nothing here loads code from a file, nothing subclasses Thread, and a handshake the platform refuses is reported rather than retried, each held by a test. Source notices that cite ReVanced's blocked GitHub repository now carry the GitLab mirror beside them, the dead legacy settings import path is gone, and thirty-odd hand-rolled register checks, entry guards and class walks inside the patch bundle became shared helpers.

Validation: 1369 runtime tests passed locally, plus the patches module suite. The bundle carries 81 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
